messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Social behaviour and attitudes, Medication and treatment, Specific diseases, disorders and medical conditions, Language and linguistics, International politics and organisations, and Political behaviour and attitudes in Belgium, Denmark, Germany, Greece, Spain, France, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Portugal, Great Britain, Northern Ireland, Austria, Sweden, and Finland during the 1990s, matching this research need: Survey data on European citizens’ attitudes toward the EU, knowledge of EU civil rights, trust in European institutions, views on integration, plus women’s breast cancer screening behavior, beliefs, information sources, and demographics.
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: GESIS Eurobarometer 1990s European citizenship rights trust institutions integration breast cancer screening women information sources
GESIS Eurobarometer breast cancer screening 1990s beliefs information sources dataset
Eurobarometer 1996 EU citizens rights knowledge survey dataset ZA
